# Every command

<!-- Generated by `ase --dump-docs`. Do not edit: your changes will be
     overwritten the next time the docs are built. -->

Every action the editor can be asked to perform, under a name. These are
the names the right-hand side of a `key.` setting takes — see
[Keybindings](../guide/keybindings.md).

Each can also be typed on the `:` line — `:editor.find` — alongside the
ex-commands listed in [The command line](../guide/command-line.md). Both
paths resolve a name the same way. See docs/adr/0128.

## Editor

Act on the buffer you are in.

| Command | Does | Default keys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `editor.about` | About this editor | Alt+I |
| `editor.command-line` | Open the command line | Alt+; |
| `editor.compile` | Run the build command | Alt+B |
| `editor.copy` | Copy | Ctrl+C |
| `editor.cursor.add-next-occurrence` | Add a cursor at the next match | Ctrl+D |
| `editor.cut` | Cut | Ctrl+X |
| `editor.document-symbols` | Outline of this file | Alt+S |
| `editor.find` | Find in this buffer | Ctrl+F |
| `editor.find-in-project` | Find across the project | Alt+F |
| `editor.find-references` | Every use of the symbol under the cursor | Shift+F12 |
| `editor.font.larger` | Larger text | Ctrl+=, Ctrl++ |
| `editor.font.reset` | Text back to the configured size | Ctrl+0 |
| `editor.font.smaller` | Smaller text | Ctrl+- |
| `editor.go-to-definition` | Go to definition | F12 |
| `editor.help` | Show every keyboard shortcut | F1 |
| `editor.jump-back` | Back to the previous jump | Ctrl+O, Alt+Left |
| `editor.jump-forward` | Forward again | Ctrl+I, Alt+Right |
| `editor.open` | Open a file | Alt+O |
| `editor.open-in-project` | Open any file in the project by name | Ctrl+P |
| `editor.output-panel` | Toggle the build output | Alt+P |
| `editor.output-panel.shorter` | Give the editor more room | Ctrl+W then - |
| `editor.output-panel.taller` | Give the output panel more room | Ctrl+W then +, Ctrl+W then = |
| `editor.paste` | Paste the system clipboard | Ctrl+V |
| `editor.quit` | Quit | Ctrl+Q |
| `editor.redo` | Redo | Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+R (normal), Ctrl+R (insert), Ctrl+R (visual) |
| `editor.replace` | Find and replace | Ctrl+H |
| `editor.replace-in-project` | Replace across the project | Alt+R |
| `editor.save` | Save the file | Ctrl+S |
| `editor.save-as` | Save under a different name | Ctrl+Shift+S |
| `editor.select-all` | Select the whole buffer | Ctrl+A |
| `editor.undo` | Undo | Ctrl+Z |

## Vim

Bound in Normal and Visual mode only.

| Command | Does | Default keys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vim.half-page-down` | Half a screen down | Ctrl+D (normal), Ctrl+D (visual) |
| `vim.half-page-up` | Half a screen up | Ctrl+U (normal), Ctrl+U (visual) |
| `vim.number.decrement` | Subtract one from the next number | Ctrl+X (normal) |
| `vim.number.increment` | Add one to the next number | Ctrl+A (normal) |

## Buffers

Act on the list of open files.

| Command | Does | Default keys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `buffer.close` | Close this buffer | — |
| `buffer.new` | New buffer | Ctrl+N, Ctrl+W then N |
| `buffer.next` | Next buffer | Ctrl+Tab |
| `buffer.previous` | Previous buffer | Ctrl+Shift+Tab |

## Panes

Act on the regions of the window.

| Command | Does | Default keys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pane.close` | Close the focused region | Ctrl+W then C, Ctrl+W then Q |
| `pane.cycle` | Cycle between regions | Ctrl+W then W |
| `pane.focus-down` | Focus the region below | Ctrl+W then J |
| `pane.focus-up` | Focus the region above | Ctrl+W then K |
| `pane.only` | Close everything but the editor | Ctrl+W then O |
